g.text: Shared mission • independent decisions • peer conflict resolution

g.text: DRONE D18 / SAME STACK ON ALL 20

g.title: mission
g.text: ONE COMMON MISSION PACKAGE — copied onto all aircraft before launch
Permitted boundary + search objective + coordinate frame + task-generation rules + recovery constraints

g.text: Can I search and recover safely?

g.title: bid2
g.text: Resolve ties with common ID rule

g.title: policy
g.text: Continue previously agreed work • explicitly permit or defer duplicate observation
Exclusive actions require valid authorization; uncertain ownership pauses new execution

g.title: bid3
g.text: Lose T37 to D04 → select other work

g.title: fly3
g.text: Flight does not wait for dashboard

g.title: example
g.text: T37 EXAMPLE: D04 costs 6 min / D11 fails energy check / D18 costs 8 min → D04 wins after peer reconciliation
Common task IDs and comparison rules replace a central dispatcher; network assumptions still matter.

g.title: footer
g.text: Research-informed proposal: CBAA / CBBA / ACBBA • RACER for unknown-space exploration
No fixed 19-left / 1-right split. No cloud or LLM required for individual flight or peer allocation.
